cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Understand the Hurt
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge why their action hurt, not merely agree that it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I saved you a front-row seat at my concert. Do you understand why it hurt?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I told you work might run late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I knew. I still looked at that empty seat before every song.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You needed someone there who knew what this meant to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. You'd heard me practise for months. Please tell me you understand why someone else couldn't fill it.

mechanism: A corrects explanations and definitions until B acknowledges why a particular action hurt.
confusable: Demanding apology alone differs from seeking recognition of the meaning of the injury.
comparison: A concert absence denied personal witness; a job-loss reply sounded like a demand for cooking.
seedUse: Retain each exact injury and the partner's plausible intent while using correction to seek understanding.
